bio: This interesting vegan Thai food concept is a refreshing addition to the local dining scene. The Thai chef creates vegan dishes inspired by his homeland, brilliantly showcasing its flavours and styles, from street food classics such as pad thai to yellow lemongrass curry. Sweet and spicy notes are driven by a subtle heat, for a full-bodied yet mild flavour profile. The interior is a colourful and lively mix of authentic furnishing details and original accessories – this creates a cheerful and relaxed atmosphere.
